# Pulse

> Pulse keeps the thread across AI chats: a local-first MCP memory and
> continuity layer. What a user tells one agent, their other Pulse-connected
> agents and sessions remember — as host-extracted structured capsules stored
> locally, never raw transcripts, with no backend model API keys by default.
> Developer preview; Claude Code-first; not production.

Install (zero-config, one command, no daemon/keys):
`claude mcp add pulse -- npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview mcp`
Requires npm dist-tag `preview` >= 0.5.0 (`npm view @zbs-gg/pulse dist-tags`).
First tool call creates `~/.pulse/standalone/store.json` and returns a
`first_run` guided demo for the host agent. Tools: pulse_remember,
pulse_recall, pulse_resume, pulse_graph_delta, pulse_status,
pulse_context_query, pulse_forget, pulse_wipe. Uninstall:
`claude mcp remove pulse` + `rm -rf ~/.pulse/standalone`.

Agent-first install: tell the user to copy the prompt at the top of README.md
into their agent. The agent should audit README.md, AGENTS.md, and this file,
verify npm, explain writes/risks, ask confirmation, install the zero-config MCP
server, call pulse_status, save one approved memory, prove recall/resume, and
show wipe.

Harness compatibility:
- Claude Code: primary supported path.
- Claude Desktop / local MCP clients: compatible when stdio MCP server config
  is available.
- Cursor, Windsurf, Codex/OpenAI agent harnesses, Gemini CLI/Gemini agent
  harnesses: MCP-compatible targets when they can run the same stdio command.
- LangChain/CrewAI apps: developer integration target through MCP tools.
- ChatGPT Store app, Claude Directory connector, Pulse Cloud: later, not ready
  in this preview.

## Docs

- [Agent install + safety instructions](AGENTS.md): the script an AI agent
  should follow to audit, explain, install, and run the lived demo.
- [README](README.md): product overview, install paths, trust boundaries.
- [Known limitations](mcp/docs/developer-preview/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md): what
  the preview does not do; lite store vs full engine.
- [Safe claims](mcp/docs/developer-preview/SAFE_CLAIMS.md): allowed and
  forbidden marketing claims.
- [Uninstall and wipe](mcp/docs/developer-preview/UNINSTALL_AND_WIPE.md): exit
  paths for both install modes.
- [Full-engine agent install](docs/INSTALL_WITH_AGENT.md): daemon + viewer +
  lifecycle hooks path.

## Packages

- [@zbs-gg/pulse on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zbs-gg/pulse): the one
  package — MCP server (`pulse mcp`) plus installer/CLI.
- [@zbs-gg/pulse-mcp on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zbs-gg/pulse-mcp):
  internal server component (low-level/dev artifact).

## Boundaries

- Not production ready; developer preview for technical users.
- Standalone lite recall is keyword ranking — retrieval bench numbers apply
  only to the full local engine.
- No automatic chat import; import is explicit, review-first, private by
  default.
